name: refined
label: Refined
css: .style-refined { --slide-primary: #3B82F6; --slide-secondary: #8B5CF6; --slide-success: #16A34A; --slide-warning: #D97706; --slide-danger: #DC2626; --slide-surface: #FFFFFF; --slide-text: #111827; --slide-text-muted: #6B7280; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; padding: 64px; background-color: var(--slide-surface); font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .style-refined::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; width: 400px; height: 400px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.08) 0%, transparent 70%); pointer-events: none; } .style-refined .hook { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--slide-text); margin: 0; max-width: 900px; letter-spacing: -1px; } .style-refined .text { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--slide-text); margin: 0; max-width: 850px; } .style-refined .step { position: absolute; top: 64px; right: 64px; font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-text); opacity: 0.08; line-height: 1; margin: 0; } .style-refined .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 64px; left: 64px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0; } .slide-code.style-refined { --slide-primary: #3B82F6; --slide-surface: #0F172A; --slide-text: #F8FAFC; --slide-text-muted: #94A3B8; background-color: var(--slide-surface); background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.05) 0%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.03) 100%); } .slide-code.style-refined::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12) 0%, transparent 70%); } .slide-code.style-refined .hook { color: var(--slide-text); } .slide-code.style-refined .text { color: var(--slide-text); } .slide-code.style-refined .step { color: var(--slide-text); opacity: 0.12; } .slide-code.style-refined .brand { color: var(--slide-text-muted); } .slide-insight.style-refined { --slide-primary: #8B5CF6; --slide-surface: #1F1535; --slide-text: #F5F3FF; --slide-text-muted: #C4B5FD; background-color: var(--slide-surface); background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.12) 0%, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.04) 100%); } .slide-insight.style-refined::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.15) 0%, transparent 70%); } .slide-insight.style-refined .hook { color: var(--slide-text); } .slide-insight.style-refined .text { color: var(--slide-text); } .slide-insight.style-refined .insight-text { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--slide-text); margin: 0; max-width: 900px; } .slide-insight.style-refined .step { color: var(--slide-text); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-refined .brand { color: var(--slide-text-muted); }
